messages.text: ============================================================                  DELTA LAN MESSENGER 2.0 ============================================================         Private Communication. Local Control.                   Your Network.  Delta LAN Messenger is a self-hosted, Discord-inspired communication platform designed for Local Area Networks.  It allows users connected to the same private network to communicate through a web browser without requiring public internet services during normal operation.  The application uses a central Ubuntu server and supports real-time messaging, multiple servers, text channels, administrative roles, file sharing, folder sharing and browser-based voice communication.  ============================================================ 1. FEATURES ============================================================  MESSAGING - Real-time text messaging. - Multiple servers. - Multiple text channels. - Persistent message history. - Online member presence.  SERVER MANAGEMENT - Create and join servers. - Discover available servers. - Switch and leave servers. - Server settings. - Member management.  ROLES AND PERMISSIONS - Server Owner. - Administrator. - Member. - Channel creation and management. - Channel access restrictions.  FILE SHARING - Individual file sharing. - Multiple file uploads. - Complete folder sharing. - Folder structure preservation. - Upload progress. - ZIP folder downloads.  VOICE COMMUNICATION - Real-time browser voice chat. - WebRTC peer-to-peer audio. - Microphone mute controls. - Join and leave voice channels.  ============================================================ 2. TECHNOLOGY STACK ============================================================  Backend: Node.js Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript Real-time Communication: WebSockets Voice: WebRTC Storage: JSON and Local Filesystem Security: HTTPS Server: Ubuntu Linux Client: Windows, Linux and compatible browsers  ============================================================ 3. REQUIREMENTS ============================================================  SERVER: - Ubuntu Linux. - Node.js 18 or newer. - npm. - OpenSSL. - Available storage for uploaded files.  CLIENT: - Windows, Linux or another compatible operating system. - Chrome, Microsoft Edge or another supported browser. - Connection to the same reachable private LAN.  ============================================================ 4. INSTALLATION ON UBUNTU ============================================================  STEP 1: UPDATE THE SYSTEM  sudo apt update sudo apt upgrade -y  STEP 2: INSTALL REQUIRED PACKAGES  sudo apt install -y nodejs npm openssl unzip dos2unix  STEP 3: CHECK NODE.JS  node --version npm --version  Ensure Node.js is version 18 or newer.  STEP 4: EXTRACT THE PROJECT  Extract the downloaded project ZIP file.  Navigate into the extracted project directory:  cd /path/to/delta-lan-messenger-v2  Replace the example path with your actual project location.  STEP 5: SET FILE PERMISSIONS  sudo chown -R "$USER":"$USER" .  STEP 6: FIX SCRIPT LINE ENDINGS  dos2unix scripts/*.sh  STEP 7: MAKE INSTALLATION SCRIPTS EXECUTABLE  chmod +x scripts/*.sh  STEP 8: INSTALL THE APPLICATION  ./scripts/install-ubuntu.sh  The installation script prepares dependencies, environment configuration and HTTPS certificates.  STEP 9: START THE APPLICATION  npm start  Your Delta LAN Messenger server should now be running.  ============================================================ 5. ACCESS THE APPLICATION ============================================================  After starting the server, access it through a browser.  Use the server's local network address:  https://SERVER-LAN-IP:5000  Replace SERVER-LAN-IP with the actual LAN IP address of the Ubuntu server.  For local testing on the Ubuntu computer:  https://localhost:5000  The HTTPS certificate must be trusted by client browsers for reliable microphone access.  ============================================================ 6. FIND YOUR SE
